newsitem.title: FINLAND: LAROX SAYS GROWTH PROSPECTS GOOD.
newsitem.headline: LAROX SAYS GROWTH PROSPECTS GOOD.

text.p: Finnish industrial filters and valve maker Larox Oy said on Wednesday prospects were good and that its 20 percent annual growth target was within reach.
"The group's economic development is expected to continue to be positive," Larox said.
"The advantages of the solutions that Larox offers to its customers and the large size of the market provide good opportunities to achieve the 20 percent annual growth target," it said.
"Some uncertainty in the near term stems from the timing of customers' investments, the effect of which will even out in the longer term as volumes rise," it said.
